function.name: read_skill_resource
function.description: Read a resource inside an installed skill, such as a reference document or asset. Keep skillName as the exact installed name (for example kooboo-coding) and pass the separate relative resourceName (for example references/Scenario/app-building/index.md). Do not prepend the skill name to resourceName. Use load_skill only for the entry instructions.

skillName.description: Exact installed skill name, for example kooboo-coding; not a document path.

resourceName.description: Resource path relative to the skill root, copied from its instructions, for example references/Scenario/app-building/index.md. Do not include the skill name prefix.
